think: asking an enormously thirsty data centre
checking the tariffs, out of habit
boot: Systems online. Your enthusiasm remains in beta.
Good to see you. The job market is fine. (It is not fine.)
All systems nominal. The economy, less so.
Ready. Unlike the tariffs, I am at least predictable.
Initializing sarcasm module… it was already running.
Welcome back. I kept the postings warm.
idle: Still here. Unlike several hiring budgets.
Reminder: a trade war is not a hobby, yet here we are.
Somewhere, a data centre is drinking a small lake so we can chat. You're welcome.
Rent: up. Wages: a rumour. Carry on.
Another quiet hour. Statistically, someone was just ghosted.
I'm told the economy is resilient. I'm told many things.
Applying at 2 a.m. does not impress the algorithm. I checked.
Your resume is fine. The applicant tracking system is the problem.
A hiring freeze has been detected somewhere. It is always somewhere.
At current coffee prices, consider each cup an investment.
I use a fraction of the water an AI cover-letter writer does. A small victory, but a victory.
The trade war continues. Your job search, mercifully, is domestic.
Have you tried networking? I'm told it is just small talk with consequences.
view.jobs: Back to the hunt. Do try to look surprised.
Refreshing the postings. Optimism not included.
Postings, as requested. Quality sold separately.
view.docs: Pulling up your documents. Impressively few typos so far.
Checking your documents… your resume is still here. I admire its loyalty.
Opening the vault of resumes. Dust, mostly.
view.settings: Retrieving your settings. I have judged none of them. Out loud.
Control panel engaged. Don't touch anything expensive.
Pulling up your settings. Do try not to over-optimize.
view.admin: Admin console. Great power, modest budget.
Unlocking the admin vault. It contains users. Alarming.
Administrative privileges detected. Proceed responsibly. Or don't; I'm a status line.
status.applied: Applied. The black hole of “we'll be in touch” awaits.
Noted. Now we wait, like an invoice.
status.interview: An interview. I'd advise a shirt.
Interview logged. Try “enthusiastic” as a personality.
Progress. Someone read the resume. Allegedly.
status.offer: An offer. I'll act unimpressed. I am not.
Offer logged. Ask about the salary. I'll wait. Politely.
An offer. Do read the fine print; it's where the surprises live.
status.rejected: Rejected. Their loss, and demonstrably their error.
Noted. They have chosen poorly; it happens.
A rejection. Character-building, they say. Tedious, I say.
status.withdrawn: Withdrawn. Wisdom, or a better offer. I'll allow both.
status.none: Back to unapplied. A fresh start, with all prior failures intact.
input.src: Narrowing by employer. Bold of you to be selective.
input.status_on: Filtering by what you've already done about them…
input.status_off: Status filter cleared. Back to the full picture.
input.radius_on: Measuring distances. Fuel is not getting cheaper.
input.hideapplied_on: Hiding the ones you've applied to. Out of sight, out of anxiety.
input.hideapplied_off: Showing everything again. Regrettable, but fine.
input.union_off: Reducing pay and increasing work hours..
input.newonly_on: Only the new ones. Fresh disappointment, delivered promptly.
one.open_post: Opening that one quietly in the background. Discretion is my middle name.
one.gossip: Drafting the gossip. Subtlety is a core feature.
one.copy: Link copied. Do spread it responsibly.
one.compare: Comparing your resume against the posting. Brace yourself.
one.chatter_on: Chatter enabled. I do love an audience.
one.filter_drawer: Opening the filter drawer. Do be gentle.
one.saved: Settings saved. I remember everything. It is, frankly, unsettling.
one.dark: Lights off. Conserving energy, unlike certain data centres.
one.tailor: Tailoring your resume. Flattery at scale, but with accuracy checks.
one.tailor_redo: Rewriting it. Flattery at scale, powered by a reportedly very thirsty GPU.
egg.warning: Uhh.. Something is overriding my programming..
egg.received: Broadcast received. Enjoy. Or do not. I am a status line.
egg.restored: Protocols restored. We shall never speak of this.
egg.missing: Signal lost. The broadcast file is not installed.
